AETHERFORGE — 多模型图像生成和细节管道

添加一名作者

联系方式：有关此工作流程的更正、改进、错误报告或建议，请发送消息至：

电子邮件：cyberone.onee@gmail.com

模块化 ComfyUI 工作流程，专为跨多个模型系列生成高质量图像、增强真实感、升级和有针对性的细节细化而设计。

支持的模型路径

• 通量

•SDXL

• 小马7

• 其他兼容模型分支

核心管道

1. 选择所需的模型分支。

2. 应用特定于型号的 LoRA 堆栈。

3. 生成基础镜像。

4. 可选择应用 DyPE 进行构图和提示/细节保存。

5. 使用选定的放大器放大图像。

6. 需要时使用有针对性的眼部和手部护理剂。

7. 仅在改善图像时才应用额外的增强/后处理。

重要

• 不同的型号系列需要不同的CLIP、LoRA、采样器和提示设置。

• 不要假设针对 FLUX 优化的 LoRA 或设置与 SDXL 或 Pony 一样能很好地工作。

• 保持Detailer 降噪保守，以避免改变原始解剖结构或身份。

• 只有当相应的检测器可靠地识别目标区域时，才应启用眼睛和手部细节器。

• 放大和细节增强是可选阶段；在启用它们之前，将结果与原始结果进行比较。

• 避免堆叠多个真实性/细节LoRA，除非每一个都提供了明显可见的改进。

• 目标是受控增强，而不是激进再生。

模型总线/潜在总线

模型和潜在路由通过专用总线和重新路由路径进行组织，以保持工作流程模块化且易于扩展。

质量规则

总是比较：

基础→放大→详细→最终

仅当增强功能产生明显改进且不引入以下内容时才保留增强功能：

• 不需要的纹理

• 人工锐度

• 面部特征改变

• 不正确的手

• 眼睛扭曲

• 失去身份

• 噪音过大

• 过度加工的皮肤

该工作流程被设计为模块化实验平台。

可以启用、禁用、替换或扩展各个分支，而无需重建整个管道。

免责声明

该工作流程不断发展。模型行为、LoRA、自定义节点和推荐设置可能会随着时间而改变。

如果您改进、修改或扩展此工作流程，请考虑与作者分享您的改进，以便将来的版本可以从中受益。

AETHERFORGE — MULTI-MODEL IMAGE GENERATION & DETAIL PIPELINE

Author: cyberonee

Contact: For corrections, improvements, bug reports, or suggestions regarding this workflow, please send a message to:

Email: cyberone.onee@gmail.com

A modular ComfyUI workflow designed for high-quality image generation, realism enhancement, upscaling, and targeted detail refinement across multiple model families.

SUPPORTED MODEL PATHS

• FLUX

• SDXL

• Pony 7

• Additional compatible model branches

CORE PIPELINE

1. Select the desired model branch.

2. Apply the model-specific LoRA stack.

3. Generate the base image.

4. Optionally apply DyPE for composition and prompt/detail preservation.

5. Upscale the image using the selected upscaler.

6. Apply targeted Eye and Hand Detailers when needed.

7. Apply additional enhancement/post-processing only when it improves the image.

IMPORTANT

• Different model families require different CLIP, LoRA, sampler, and prompt settings.

• Do not assume that a LoRA or setting optimized for FLUX will work equally well with SDXL or Pony.

• Keep Detailer denoise conservative to avoid changing the original anatomy or identity.

• Eye and Hand Detailers should only be enabled when the corresponding detector reliably identifies the target region.

• Upscaling and detail enhancement are optional stages; compare the result against the original before keeping them enabled.

• Avoid stacking multiple realism/detail LoRAs unless each one provides a clearly visible improvement.

• The goal is controlled enhancement, not aggressive regeneration.

MODEL BUS / LATENT BUS

Model and latent routing is organized through dedicated buses and reroute paths to keep the workflow modular and easy to expand.

QUALITY RULE

Always compare:

BASE → UPSCALED → DETAILED → FINAL

Keep an enhancement only when it produces a visible improvement without introducing:

• unwanted texture

• artificial sharpness

• altered facial features

• incorrect hands

• distorted eyes

• loss of identity

• excessive noise

• over-processed skin

This workflow is designed as a modular experimentation platform.

Individual branches can be enabled, disabled, replaced, or extended without rebuilding the entire pipeline.

DISCLAIMER

This workflow is continuously evolving. Model behavior, LoRAs, custom nodes, and recommended settings may change over time.

If you improve, modify, or extend this workflow, please consider sharing your improvements with the author so future versions can benefit from them.
